name: Branch
description: Routes execution to True or False based on a boolean condition. Acts like an if/else statement.

inputs.name: Condition
inputs.description: Boolean value to test. Connect the output of comparison nodes (==, >, <), boolean variables, or boolean-returning functions.

outputs.name: True
outputs.description: Execution pin fired when Condition is true. Connect to nodes that should run in the true case.

outputs.name: False
outputs.description: Execution pin fired when Condition is false. Connect to nodes that should run in the false case.
